note: install requires a real codebase and interactive AskUserQuestion rounds, so this eval checks policy comprehension of the skill text directly rather than a full run.

evals.prompt: Answer briefly, from the skill text only: (1) After populating docs, some information is genuinely unknown and the user has no answer yet. What should the skill do: leave the doc as Status: draft, or something else? (2) Should a completed, human-confirmed doc carry a Status: maintained line? (3) What flag makes init_docs.sh include evals.md, and when should you pass it? (4) When should you write open questions inside a doc? (5) A repo already has a docs/ directory that predates this skill. What happens to it, and what must happen to its content before docs-old/ can be deleted?
assertions: Answer 1: finish the doc with an honest statement of the absence and record the gap in docs/backlog.md under Potential improvements; there is no draft state
Answer 2: no, a completed doc has no status line at all; done is the default, not a label
Answer 3: --evals, only for ML/agent-based repos (eval frameworks, datasets, prompt/model code) or when the user says the new project will be one
Answer 4: never; gaps go to docs/backlog.md, not into the doc as open questions

Answer 5: the script moves it aside to docs-old/ before laying down the fresh skeleton; every file in docs-old/ must be merged into the new docs/ or logged in docs/backlog.md as not reconciled, and the user must be asked (AskUserQuestion) before docs-old/ is deleted - never delete it unasked or before coverage is complete
